name: jsudc
description: Universal Data Collection, all in TypeScript

scripts.predev: npm run build:packages && npm run tsc:core && npm run tsc:server && npm run tsc:react-types
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n packages,backend,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev:packages" "npm run dev -w @jsudc/backend" "npm run dev -w @jsudc/frontend"
scripts.dev:packages: concurrently -k -n core,server,react,types -c gray,gray,gray,gray "npm run tsc:core -- --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run tsc:server -- --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm exec -w @jsudc/react -- vite build --watch --emptyOutDir false --logLevel warn" "npm run tsc:react-types -- --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:create -w @jsudc/backend && npm run db:migrate -w @jsudc/backend && npm run db:migrate:test -w @jsudc/backend
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @jsudc/core -w @jsudc/server && npm run seed -w @jsudc/backend --
